findings: l.794-795 and l.798 say Gamma_p is 'generated by' a hyperbolic, resp. parabolic, element. The remark needs k-th roots in Gamma_p: a degree-2k circle with Gamma_p-holonomy rho covers a degree-2 one only through a k-th root of rho in Gamma_p, which a cyclic Gamma_p would not provide (argued). Proved: at p in dS^2 every element of Gamma_p is a boost of p^perp (GX.GammaP.exists_eq_dsBoost), at a light-like p a null rotation (GX.GammaP.exists_eq_nullBoost), so Gamma_p is the image of a one-parameter group and has k-th roots (GX.GammaP.exists_pow_eq). This formalizes the content OQ-122 (a) argued.

With trivial Gamma_p-holonomy (g = 1) the remark degenerates: the base L_1 has lifted holonomy delta^2, that of a regular point's link, and the k-fold cover (degree 2k) is neither hyperbolic nor parabolic (GX.exists_kfold_cover_regular, which builds the k-fold cover of l(p) that GX.regular_not_isHyperbolic only argued). So 'k-branched cover of a space-like singularity of degree 2' holds with a singular (hyperbolic) base exactly when the degree-2k singularity is hyperbolic, which the assembly proves (g hyperbolic iff g_1 hyperbolic). Not a defect of the remark; the l.785-800 list omits these cyclic covers (already a finding of T-bbs-hs-link-types).

For k >= 2 the branched cover of the suspensions is branched exactly at the two apices (GX.notMem_ordY_susp_map, branchingLocus = poles), k-to-one off them and one-to-one over each: the k-branched cover the remark names.
questions: 'k-branched cover' (l.1334) is not defined for singular HS-surfaces or AdS-spacetimes. Reading taken: at the link, a k-sheeted covering L -> L_1 which is a (Gamma_p, l(p))-morphism; at the HS level, BiSusp.map pr : e(L) -> e(L_1) an HS-morphism (GX.SingularHSStructure.IsMorphism) and a branched covering in gx's sense (GX.IsBranchedCovering), possibly branched over the apices, exactly there for k >= 2. Is gx's notion the one of record?

'can be constructed as' (l.1334): read three ways, all proved (every degree 2k is a k-fold cover of a degree 2; the k-fold cover of a degree 2 has degree 2k; both signs occur in every degree). Which is of record for the mark?
e(L) depends on developing data (OQ-126 (c)): the HS half is stated for every Delta_1 of L_1 with the pulled-back Delta of L; e(L) for another Delta of L is not compared.
'with its sign kept' (the target's wording, not the paper's): positive/negative in the l.915 form (OQ-120 (c)) with i^pm time-like (OQ-116 (a)); proved preserved both ways (kfold_sign).

findings: The light-like twin has no link-level sentence of its own; at the link it is the light-like case of bbsrem:degk: every light-like (Gamma_p, l(p))-circle of degree 2k is the k-fold cover of one of degree 2 (the k-th root is a null rotation by 1/k of the parameter), type and sign kept, and positive and negative light-like singularities exist in every degree 2k (GX.exists_lightlike_degree_two_mul).
questions: Read as the light-like case of bbsrem:degk's link and HS content (the printed sentence is AdS only); the same readings as there.

kb_proposals: Gamma_p at a non-time-like p is a one-parameter group: GX.GammaP.exists_eq_dsBoost (boosts of p^perp in the frame (Q(p)^{-1/2} dsU p, jVec p)) and GX.GammaP.exists_eq_nullBoost (null rotations about p in the direction jVec p); compare elements by their tangent actions on two independent vectors with GX.GammaP.eq_of_tangent_eq; k-th roots GX.GammaP.exists_pow_eq.

The k-fold cover of a (Gamma_p, l(p))-circle: GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.exists_kfold_cover (f = f_1^k, f_1 fixed-point-free) normalises the pair to (E', D_1(k .)) with pr (E' s) = E_1 (k s); the covering property comes from IsCoveringMapOn.of_openPartialHomeomorph (compact source, T2 target, local homeomorphism from IsGXMorphism), the fibre count from GX.card_fiber_of_kfold.
Two periodic coverings of one circle differ by a homeomorphism psi of R with psi (s + 1) = psi s +- 1: GX.IsPeriodicCover.exists_rel (lift, IVT for |eps| = 1, Equiv.toHomeomorphOfContinuousOpen).

A branched covering of suspensions: GX.isBranchedCovering_susp_map is the template (spread through the tube lemma GX.BiSusp.exists_ht_subset at the apices and exists_cc_subset_of_isEvenlyCovered elsewhere; completeness through ends; complete_path_carac.{0}); an HS-morphism is a local homeomorphism off the singular set (GX.SingularHSStructure.IsMorphism.isLocalHomeomorphOn).

LocPathConnectedSpace Sph2 is not an instance at this pin; get it on BiSusp L from GX.IsTopologicalSurface.locPathConnectedSpace (a ChartedSpace built from exists_chart, then ChartedSpace.locPathConnectedSpace).
